description: Normalize a free-form US postal address to USPS Publication 28 style, deterministically (rule tables, no AI): uppercase, standard street-suffix, directional and unit abbreviations (Street -> ST, Suite -> STE, North -> N), state names to 2-letter codes, ZIP/ZIP+4 cleanup, and a parsed breakdown (house number, street, unit, city, state, ZIP). Formatting only — it does not verify the address is deliverable. Non-US addresses get whitespace cleanup only.

address.description: Full address on one line or several, e.g. '1600 Pennsylvania Avenue Northwest, Washington, District of Columbia 20500'

country.description: ISO country code (default US; only US gets full normalization)

name: address_normalize
title: Address Normalize
